item.title: Ahbar Günlük Bülten — Sayı #30 (2026-11-17)
item.description:
Ahbar Sayı #30 (2026-11-17):
1. [Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım] Discord Patch Notes: November 9, 2026. Check out the finer details of the more technical fixes implemented into Discord recently. — Discord Systems & Database Engineering (Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım) Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım alanında Discord Systems & Database Engineering tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Check out the finer details of the more technical fixes implemented into Discord recently.
2. [Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi] AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data — Hugging Face Daily Papers (Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi) Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi alanında Hugging Face Daily Papers tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Real-world portfolio management requires converting noisy market observations into coordinated, simultaneous allocations across multiple assets under shared capital constraints. Advances in forecasting models and alpha discovery help identify opportunities. However, traditional pipelines often decouple signal forecasting from portfolio construction, potentially misaligning learning with allocation and execution objectives.
3. [Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler] Peak state transfer in trees and the cost of distance — arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) (Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler) Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler alanında arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: There is peak state transfer between vertices $u$ and $v$ in a graph $G$ if there exists a time $t$ for which $|(\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm i t M})_{u,v}|$ saturates the triangle inequality imposed by its spectral decomposition and $M$ is either the adjacency or Laplacian matrix. We show that peak state transfer at distance $d$ requires $\frac{d^3}{24}(1 + o(1))$ edges in the adjacency case, $Ω(d^2)$ edges in the Laplacian case, and that the leading coefficient in the former is tight. We find a family of graphs with Laplacian peak state transfer at distance $d$ and $Θ(d^5)$ edges, showing that peak state transfer is achievable in a polynomial graph size.
4. [Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay] Hyperkagome antiferromagnetism in the iron garnet Almandine Fe$_3$Al$_2$Si$_3$O$_{12}$ — arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) (Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay) Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay alanında arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Antiferromagnets on the hyperkagome lattice provide a three-dimensional route to strong magnetic frustration, but experimentally accessible realizations with well-established microscopic Hamiltonians remain scarce. Garnets are a broad family of materials in which magnetic ions can form two interpenetrating hyperkagome lattices, giving rise to spin glass, spin-liquid and hidden-order physics. Here we identify the iron aluminosilicate garnet almandine, Fe$_3$Al$_2$Si$_3$O$_{12}$, as a spin-$2$ hyperkagome antiferromagnet.
5. [Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi] Security updates for Monday — LWN.net (Linux & Kernel Engineering) (Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi) Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi alanında LWN.net (Linux & Kernel Engineering) tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Security updates have been issued by AlmaLinux (.NET 10.0, .NET 8.0, .NET 9.0, firefox, gcc, grafana, grafana-pcp, gstreamer1, gstreamer1-plugins-base, java-1.8.0-openjdk, kernel, kernel-rt, libimobiledevice, mingw-libpng, nginx:1.24, nodejs:22, nodejs:24, perl-CGI, perl-DBI, qt5-qtbase, tigervnc, vim, and xorg-x11-server), Debian (apache2, c-ares, linux-6.12, node-shell-quote, nova, parted, postgresql-17,…
6. [Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi] The rise of AI in mathematics — and science — Nature Computational Science (Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi) Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi alanında Nature Computational Science tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01112-8 We discuss the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in mathematical research and explore its implications for the computational science community.
7. [Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller] Possible futures of the Ethereum protocol, part 6: The Splurge — Vitalik Buterin's Blog (Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller) Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller alanında Vitalik Buterin's Blog tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Published via Vitalik Buterin's Blog in Cryptography, Web3 & Protocols. Primary discussion and technical specification available at the linked source.
8. [Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz] Strategic Repayment and Latent Fragility in Financial Networks: Why Banks Withhold Payable Liquidity — arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) (Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz) Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz alanında arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: A network in which every bank pays in full can nevertheless admit a self-fulfilling settlement freeze under the same balance-sheet fundamentals. Thus, observing full repayment does not establish the uniqueness or robustness of the payment equilibrium. We derive this result from a precautionary-liquidity choice: banks may delay otherwise feasible payments to insure an interim funding need, trading a positive settlement-discipline cost against the marginal value of retained cash.
9. [Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji] Is China Misreading the Moment? — Foreign Affairs (Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji) Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji alanında Foreign Affairs tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: When U.S. President Donald Trump lands in Shenzhen later this week for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, he will sit down with Chinese leader Xi Jinping for the fourth time amid an unexpected détente between Washington and Beijing. The trade war of 2025 is in abeyance, the two governments have announced a relationship of “constructive strategic stability,” and, to the alarm of American allies, Trump and Xi are planning to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Beneath the surface, however, the détente is beginning to crack.
10. [Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler] Leverage-Enhanced Sampling Owen Method for Explainable Artificial Intelligence — arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) (Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler) Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler alanında arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Recently, the Shapley value has been widely applied in machine learning for feature importance analysis and model explainability. The multilinear extension of games proposed by Owen (1972) expresses the Shapley value as the integral of partial derivatives along the main diagonal of the cube. Direct evaluation of this integral requires exponential-time computation of the partial derivatives.
